subject: HC coverage gap: request for backfill exception and review-cycle impact
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sarah PeopleOps <sarah@peopleops-external.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: HC coverage gap: request for backfill exception and review-cycle impact

Hi Laura / Vivek —

Heads-up: Alex Taylor from ACME (cc'd in later threads) just accepted an offer elsewhere and will be offboarded 11/20. Alex is a senior SWE on the Realtime Serving team (critical path for the Mobile rollout). With performance reviews and calibration happening this month, I want to raise a formal request for a freeze-exception to backfill the role immediately rather than queueing it until the Jan cycle.

Why this is urgent:
- Project velocity: Alex owns the scheduler / KV cache reliability work; leaving this unfilled will create a 30–40% reduction in core sprint throughput for two quarters.
- Customer risk: Mobile customers in the EU are live in Dec; a regression during ramp risks SLA credits.
- Review timing: A delayed hire pushes onboarding post-review, making calibration and promotion planning harder for the team.

Proposed mitigations I attempted:
1) Reprioritized non-critical scope — still leaves ~2 FTE of critical work uncovered.
2) Short-term contractor — vendor quotes (BlueSky) are ~1.6x cost and need 2–3 weeks ramp.

Request:
- Approve a freeze exception to open a Senior SWE backfill (IC6) and allow immediate recruitment + expedited offer authority (up to 15% above midpoint if required).
- Approve using committed hiring budget reallocation from Q4 minor projects to cover remainder.

I attached a filled backfill request and the latest draft JD. If we cannot get an exception by EOD 11/10 I will have to redistribute Alex's on-call and delay the EU ramp.

Thanks —
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Realtime Serving
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: backfill_request_20261104.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: jd_senior_sw_eng_v2.docx (document)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 10:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: HC coverage gap: request for backfill exception and review-cycle impact

Rishi —

Thanks for the clear summary. A few quick questions before I escalate to finance and exec approvals:

1) Can you confirm the absolute minimum headcount to avoid delivery risk? You mentioned ~2 FTE; is that 2 parallel hires or one hire plus a 0.5 contractor?
2) If we approve a freeze exception now, can you commit to a hiring timeline (sourcing -> offer -> start) and a contingency plan (who covers on-call in weeks 1–8)?
3) Any possibility to reallocate existing contractors internally instead of a vendor?

We want to avoid a knee-jerk approval for all exceptions; put me in a position to sign off quickly by answering the above.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: HC coverage gap: request for backfill exception and review-cycle impact

I reviewed the backfill sheet. Quick take: I'm comfortable with an exception in principle provided a) we lock to one headcount (not two), b) we use existing hiring budget first, and c) there's a documented ramp plan with measurable milestones (2-week onboarding goal for critical infra tasks).

If hiring budget isn't available, approve a 12-week contractor engagement with BlueSky as a fallback — but prefer a direct hire for long-term ownership. Laura: if you can confirm finance will accept a reallocation from the Q4 minor projects bucket, I'll greenlight escalation to CFO.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
SVP, Product & Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: HC coverage gap: request for backfill exception and review-cycle impact

Thanks — adding People Ops intake notes and next steps.

Can you, Rishi, provide the following so we can process an expedited exception:
- Finalized job description (JD) and target interview panel (names, internal/external).
- Sourcing timeline (S1: sourcing opens 11/6, S2: interviews start 11/16, target offer 11/30).
- Confirmation on comp band flexibility (you requested up to +15%).

I've attached the backfill intake template (pre-filled with what you submitted). I can fast-track the packet to the compensation committee and get an interim approval within 48 hours if everyone signs off on the timeline and band.

[Attachment: backfill_request_20261104.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

—Marissa

Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 11:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: HC coverage gap: request for backfill exception and review-cycle impact

Laura / Marissa / Vivek —

Update based on questions:
- Minimum coverage: one Senior SWE hire (IC6) plus a short, 6-week contractor overlap to cover critical on-call during the hiring window. That reduces the 2 FTE gap to 0.6 FTE risk.
- Timeline: sourcing opens 11/10, first-round interviews 11/18–11/20, onsite loop by 11/27, target offer 11/30, start date 1/11 (ideally earlier if candidate is available).
- Comp flexibility: authorizing up to +12% over midpoint; will escalate to compensation committee only if final candidate requires more.
- Contingency owners: On-call rotation redistributed: Priya N. (week 1–2), Karthik I. (week 3–6), with me covering escalation.

I've updated the JD and attached. Please route the intake to comp committee and finance. If we get interim approval, I'll begin sourcing tomorrow and run a sourced-first plan (internal first).

Thanks —
Rishi

[Attachment: jd_senior_sw_eng_v2.docx (document)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: HC coverage gap: request for backfill exception and review-cycle impact

Approved — interim exception granted.

Decisions and next steps:
- Approval: one IC6 headcount backfill with up to +12% comp flexibility (as Rishi outlined).
- Funding: reallocation from Q4 minor projects approved; finance to mirror in budget this week.
- People Ops: Marissa to submit to comp committee and create expedited req; coordinate with Legal for offer authority.
- Vendor fallback: BlueSky contractor engagement approved (12 weeks) only if direct hire search fails to produce an accepted offer by 11/30.

Laura: please sign the attached one-off exception authorization (DocuSign). Marissa, please confirm when the req is live and share the HubSpot pipeline link.

Thanks —
Laura
VP, Engineering Operations
